name: Igor Pankin
headline: Finance Systems & ERP Product Lead
tagline: 20 years in financial ERP and FinTech: Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle ERP Cloud implementation, custom development, SaaS/PaaS and integrations, delivery with P&L ownership — and AI-agent automation on the side.

experience.description: Formal title: Lead Consultant. Delivery and P&L ownership for financial ERP projects and for in-house products taken to customers; regular participation in pre-sales (proposals, estimates, sales materials). Customers by request.
highlights: Full-cycle ownership of financial application development and implementation projects across industry, retail and other sectors: scope, budget, team, launch, support
Led the migration of a large enterprise's financial ERP platform (applications, integrations, reports, data) and the implementation of financial and tax modules for an industrial customer
Pre-sales for large telecom, chemicals, energy and mining customers: proposals, estimates, sales materials
Built IFRS and management P&L reporting automation for group finance
Portfolio of over €4.5M revenue and about €1.4M profit across 6 projects (2014–2025), ROI above 30%

experience.description: Formal title: Senior Consultant (Lead Consultant from 2021). Project management and product ownership for Oracle ERP financial solutions as an Oracle Platinum partner.
highlights: Led the Oracle ERP Cloud implementation for a major enterprise customer together with its international head-office team and a global integrator
Built a SaaS service from scratch as an extension of Oracle ERP
Developed and distributed the official Oracle localisation solution for Russia
Delivered a multi-year PaaS-based support contract for a large customer

experience.description: Development, enhancement and functional support of financial ERP applications for global industrial and retail customers (names by request).
highlights: Functional design, development and enhancement of financial modules, reports and localisation features for long-running ERP customers

experience.description: Custom financial software development and implementation of Treasury applications for energy, chemicals and utilities customers. Part of IBS Group (IBS Borlas practice) until 2012.
highlights: Business process improvement and cross-team collaboration across Treasury projects

experience.description: Oracle E-Business Suite financials implementation in one of the biggest projects in Russia, for a state telecom holding; also GL, budgeting, cash flow and treasury modules for large telecom operators.
highlights: Surveyed business processes and wrote Functional Designs for GL, CE, TR and AP customizations
Tested modules and trained junior consultants and key users
Project went live on time at a high level of performance

experience.description: Building autonomous agent systems that orchestrate workflows across messaging, scheduling, data pipelines and third-party APIs.
highlights: omb-agent — multi-agent orchestration platform (AutoGen, CrewAI, n8n, Dify)
tg-scheduler — Telegram scheduling and automation with Google services

items: Oracle ERP Cloud / Oracle Fusion Applications
